description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade and configuration functions for embedded Linux systems, particularly involving image upgrade procedures, device and partition handling, and backup management for different board types.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_sdboot
methods.description: Handles upgrading the system image stored on SD boot devices by writing kernel and root filesystem parts to device.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_traverse_slotubi
methods.description: Updates the UBI partition or slot based on the current boot parameter.

methods.name: platform_copy_config_sdboot
methods.description: Backs up configuration data to SD boot device.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration files based on the board type.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks whether the image is supported for upgrade on the current board.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade dispatcher that calls specific upgrade functions depending on board type.
